{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Chunky roll-neck sweater, relaxed cut, hip length, cream (#F2E8D5), merino wool blend

Straight-leg jeans, high rise, full length to the ankle, dark indigo (#1F2A44), stretch denim

Long coat, single-breasted with a slightly oversized cut, falls just below the knee, vivid fuchsia (#C2185B), thick wool blend with a warm lining

Ankle boots, lace-up with a lug sole, waterproof, black (#1A1A1A), smooth treated leather that stands up to snow and road salt

Wide scarf, generously sized and loosely wrapped, mustard yellow (#E0A526), soft lambswool

Knit beanie, snug fit with a folded cuff, deep plum (#4A1942), wool with a fleece lining

Gloves, classic cut, wrist length, black (#222222), leather with a warm lining

Why this works: the fuchsia coat is the focal point, so you'll stand out against the white snow and grey winter streets, and the mustard scarf and plum beanie add bold color without making the look feel messy. Cream knit and dark denim keep the base calm and neat, which suits a relaxed everyday walk with stops at cafés. The wool layers and lined accessories keep you warm at minus three, and the waterproof leather boots handle snow and salty pavements. When you step inside a café, the coat and scarf come off easily and the sweater still looks polished."}
